summary: A Yes vote authorizes $300 million in general obligation bonds, repaid at an estimated $49 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund flood and sea-level-rise protection, street repair, stormwater infrastructure, and emergency-response facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve a $300 million bond funded by a property tax to address infrastructure and public-safety needs.
tax.quote: If passed, property owners would pay approximately $49 per year for every $100,000 of assessed value

tax.text: A No vote rejects the $300 million general obligation bond, which would charge property owners approximately $49 annually for every $100,000 of assessed value.
tax.quote: It would cost property owners an estimated $49 annually per $100,000 of assessed value.
